courses.name: NISM Series VIII: Equity Derivatives
courses.description: Full question bank for the equity derivatives certification, covering futures, options, trading mechanics, clearing and settlement.
questions: Which body regulates the securities market in India?
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is the regulator for the Indian securities market.
A call option gives the buyer the right, but not the obligation, to:
Sell the underlying at the strike price
Buy the underlying at the strike price
Buy the underlying at the market price
Sell the underlying at the market price
A call option confers the right to BUY the underlying at the strike price.
A put option gives the buyer the right to:
Buy the underlying at the strike price
Sell the underlying at the strike price
Convert the option into a future
A put option confers the right to SELL the underlying at the strike price.
What is the maximum loss for the buyer of an option?
An option buyer can lose at most the premium paid, since exercising is optional.
In a futures contract, the obligation to perform rests with:
Unlike options, a futures contract obliges BOTH parties to settle.
The intrinsic value of a call option is:
Strike price minus spot price, floored at zero
Spot price minus strike price, floored at zero
Call intrinsic value = max(Spot - Strike, 0); it can never be negative.
Mark-to-market (MTM) settlement in futures is carried out:
Only when the position is closed
Futures positions are marked to market and settled daily against the closing price.
Who guarantees settlement of trades executed on a recognised stock exchange?
The clearing corporation acts as central counterparty and guarantees settlement.

courses.name: NISM Series V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors
courses.description: Practice questions on mutual fund structures, NAV, scheme types, distribution regulations and investor services.
questions: Net Asset Value (NAV) of a mutual fund scheme is calculated as:
Total assets divided by total investors
Net assets divided by number of units outstanding
Market price divided by face value
NAV = (Assets - Liabilities) / number of outstanding units.
Which registration is mandatory to distribute mutual funds in India?
Distributors must obtain an AMFI Registration Number (ARN).
An open-ended mutual fund scheme allows investors to:
Buy and redeem units on an ongoing basis
Buy units only during the NFO
Trade units only on an exchange
Open-ended schemes offer continuous purchase and redemption at NAV-based prices.
A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) allows an investor to:
Invest a fixed amount at regular intervals
An SIP invests a fixed sum at regular intervals, averaging cost over time.
Exit load in a mutual fund scheme is charged:
Exit load is deducted from redemption proceeds when units are sold within the specified period.
The trustees of a mutual fund primarily act in the interest of:
Trustees hold the fund property in trust and are accountable to unit holders.

courses.name: NISM Series I: Currency Derivatives
courses.description: Question bank covering currency markets, exchange-traded currency futures and options, and settlement mechanics.
questions: In the currency pair USD/INR, the base currency is:
In a quotation the FIRST currency is the base currency - here, USD.
Exchange-traded currency futures in India are settled in:
The currency of the buyer's choice
Exchange-traded currency derivatives in India are cash settled in Indian Rupees.
If the INR depreciates against the USD, then:
More rupees are needed to buy one dollar
Fewer rupees are needed to buy one dollar
Depreciation of the rupee means each dollar costs more rupees.
Hedging with currency futures is primarily done to:
Reduce the risk of adverse exchange rate movement
Hedging reduces exposure to unfavourable currency movements.
Initial margin in currency futures is collected to:
Cover potential losses from price movement
Initial margin covers the potential one-day loss and secures performance.
Which institution manages India's foreign exchange reserves?
The Reserve Bank of India manages foreign exchange reserves and FEMA regulations.
